essay_seeds.title: The hold after the point: how Chappelle makes the room indict itself in silence
essay_seeds.thesis: His signature move is not the joke but the silence after the heavy point — the room does the moral work in the gap he refuses to fill. Compare Louis (confessional dead-stop: the silence is HIS digestion of his own thought) and Norm (no silence at all: the room never gets to digest). Chappelle's silence is an altar call: he steps out, the room preaches to itself, he steps back in like nothing happened.

essay_seeds.title: Everybody already knows: split_knowledge as a cosmology, not a trick
essay_seeds.thesis: For most of our roster split_knowledge is an operator (a move inside a bit). For Chappelle it's the entire philosophy of comedy: the room already knows; the laugh is the sound of the knowing being said out loud. This is why his TA is systems, not individuals — you can't indict a person who doesn't already know. The graph's misinterpretation_rule captures it: story-shaped objects make the room indict itself without a verdict being stated.
outline: why story-form is the delivery vehicle for shared knowledge
the 'I shouldn't say this' frame as transgression-framing not false modesty
prediction: his best bits have TA=group and the verdict is never in the text

known_bits.title: The story that turns
known_bits.why_it_works: Tells a story with the cadence of a folktale, then the turn reveals the story was about something larger (race, power, America). garden_path: the room thinks it's a story, it's actually a thesis. The hold after the turn is the room metabolizing the double meaning.

known_bits.title: The character as a shield and a weapon
known_bits.why_it_works: Becomes a character to say the thing he couldn't say as himself. The character is the benign frame; the content is the violation. The room laughs at the character and absorbs the thesis at the same time.
